node.title: KoalaBear decomposition source-pencil compiler
node.closure: homogeneous source-pencil equivalence and challenge-field descent
node.statement: Every residual KoalaBear endpoint decomposition is equivalent to one coprime binary source pencil containing the complete source locators and fifth powers of exceptional locators, with V_act in its outer symmetric power. Two rational active fibers descend a target transform of the inner map and the outer map to F_(2130706433^6). Degree 30 factors through degree six; degree 12 has one canonical six-dimensional membership test; and the degree-two deck involution is challenge-field rational. Conditional on a missing same-record bridge, a prime-field carrier-stabilizing projectivity is power or reciprocal type. The distinct live degrees are 2,3,4,6,10,12; no owner, charge, u2 close, cap 68, or row close is claimed.
